summary: Teacher urges preservation of E-Rate program and its benefits for modern education infrastructure

claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to build and maintain connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
